tool_schemas.name: create_branch
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new branch in the specified Codeup repository from the provided source ref (branch/tag/commit) and returns the created branch metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id/branch_name/ref are missing or malformed, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if your access token cannot write to the repository. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or ref does not exist, and CONFLICT if a branch with the same name already exists.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID to create the branch in (yunx_code_01J...).

branch_name.description: Name of the new branch to create.

ref.description: Source ref to create the branch from (e.g., commit SHA or existing branch name).

tool_schemas.name: get_branch
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for a single branch (for example name and last update information) in the given Codeup repository. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id or branch_name is missing/invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have read access to the repository. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist or the branch name cannot be resolved.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID that contains the branch (yunx_code_01J...).

tool_schemas.name: delete_branch
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified branch from a Codeup repository and returns a success result for the deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id or branch_name is missing/invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have permission to delete branches. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or branch does not exist, and CONFLICT if the branch cannot be deleted due to repository rules or branch state (for example protected/default branch).

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID that contains the branch (yunx_code_01J...).

tool_schemas.name: list_branches
tool_schemas.description: Lists branches in a Codeup repository and returns a page of branch items ordered by the requested sort field and order; when cursor is provided, it returns the next page after that cursor. The response is paged with limit (1–200) and an opaque cursor for subsequent requests. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid repository_id, limit, sort, order, or cursor, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN for insufficient access, and NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID to list branches for (yunx_code_01J...).

search.description: Optional substring to filter branches by name.

limit.description: Maximum number of branches to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination to fetch the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_file_blobs
tool_schemas.description: Returns the content and metadata for a file at the given path resolved at the specified ref (branch/tag/commit) in a Codeup repository. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repository_id/path/ref is missing or invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack read access. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository, ref, or path does not exist (or does not resolve to a file blob).

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID to read the file from (yunx_code_01J...).

ref.description: Git ref to read from (branch name, tag, or commit SHA).

tool_schemas.name: create_file
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new file at the given path on the specified branch, committing the provided content (utf-8 or base64) with the supplied commit message, and returns the created file/commit result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, if content_encoding is not one of the supported values, or if identifiers are malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you cannot push to the repository/branch. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or branch does not exist, and CONFLICT if the file already exists at that path or the write cannot be applied due to branch protection or commit constraints.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID to create the file in (yunx_code_01J...).

branch_name.description: Branch name to create the file on.

path.description: File path to create within the repository.

commit_message.description: Commit message for the file creation commit.

author_user_id.description: User ID to attribute as the commit author (yunx_idn_01J...).

tool_schemas.name: update_file
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing file at the given path on the specified branch by committing the new content (utf-8 or base64) with the supplied commit message, and returns the update/commit result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing, if content_encoding is invalid, or if identifiers are malformed; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you cannot push to the repository/branch. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository, branch, or file path does not exist, and CONFLICT if the update cannot be applied due to repository rules or branch protection.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID containing the file (yunx_code_01J...).

branch_name.description: Branch name to update the file on.

path.description: File path within the repository to update.

commit_message.description: Commit message for the update commit.

author_user_id.description: User ID to attribute as the commit author (yunx_idn_01J...).

tool_schemas.name: delete_file
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the file at the given path on the specified branch by creating a delete commit with the provided commit message, and returns the delete/commit result. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing or malformed, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you cannot push to the repository/branch. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository, branch, or path does not exist, and CONFLICT if the delete cannot be applied due to branch protection or repository rules.

repository_id.description: Codeup repository ID containing the file (yunx_code_01J...).

branch_name.description: Branch name to delete the file from.

path.description: File path within the repository to delete.

commit_message.description: Commit message for the delete commit.

author_user_id.description: User ID to attribute as the commit author (yunx_idn_01J...).

tool_schemas.name: compare
tool_schemas.description: Compares sourceRef and targetRef within a Codeup repository and returns the comparison result (such as differences/changes), optionally restricted to a single file or directory via path. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repositoryId/sourceRef/targetRef are missing or invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have read access. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository or either ref cannot be resolved, and CONFLICT if the comparison cannot be computed for the given refs (for example incompatible or unsupported compare inputs).

repositoryId.description: Codeup repository ID to compare within.

sourceRef.description: Source ref to compare from (branch name, tag, or commit SHA).

targetRef.description: Target ref to compare to (branch name, tag, or commit SHA).

path.description: Optional path filter to limit comparison to a file or directory.

tool_schemas.name: get_repository
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for a Codeup repository identified by repositoryId. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if repositoryId is missing/invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to view the repository. Raises NOT_FOUND if the repository does not exist or is not visible in your organization context.

tool_schemas.name: list_repositories
tool_schemas.description: Lists Codeup repositories in the specified organization and returns a paged result set ordered by the requested sort, where each response includes up to `limit` items and a `cursor` to request the next page when more results are available. You can filter by `projectId`, `status`, and `search` (matched against repository name). Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid IDs/enum values or out-of-range paging parameters, `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when the token cannot access the organization or repositories, and `NOT_FOUND` when `organizationId` (or the specified `projectId`) does not exist or is not visible to the caller.

organizationId.description: Organization ID whose repositories to list.

projectId.description: Optional project ID to filter repositories linked to a project.

search.description: Search term matched against repository name.

limit.description: Maximum number of repositories to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_change_request
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full details for a single Codeup change request identified by `changeRequestId`. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if the ID format is invalid, `NOT_FOUND` if the change request does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token is not permitted to read change requests in the owning repository/organization.

tool_schemas.name: list_change_requests
tool_schemas.description: Lists change requests for a repository within an organization and returns a paged result set (up to `limit` per page) with a `cursor` for fetching the next page, optionally filtered by status, source/target branch, author, and reviewer, and sorted by the requested field. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid IDs/enum values or out-of-range paging parameters, `NOT_FOUND` if the `organizationId` or `repositoryId` does not exist or is not visible, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token lacks permission to view change requests for the repository.

organizationId.description: Organization ID to scope change requests.

repositoryId.description: Repository ID to list change requests for.

reviewerUserId.description: Filter change requests where this user is a reviewer.

sortBy.description: Field to sort change requests by.

limit.description: Maximum number of change requests to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: create_change_request
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new change request in the specified repository from `sourceBranch` to `targetBranch`, optionally setting `title`/`description`, assigning `reviewerUserIds`, linking `workItemIds`, recording cross-project context via `sourceProjectId`/`targetProjectId`, and creating an initial comment from `commentBody`, and returns the created change request. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if required fields are missing, IDs/enums are invalid, branches are empty/invalid, or reviewer/work item lists contain invalid IDs; raises `NOT_FOUND` if the organization, repository, referenced projects, reviewers, or work items do not exist or are not visible; raises `CONFLICT` if the requested change request cannot be created due to repository state or an invalid source/target relationship (for example, source and target branches are the same). Also raises `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` when the token is not allowed to create change requests in the repository.

organizationId.description: Organization ID that owns the repository.

repositoryId.description: Repository ID to create the change request in.

sourceProjectId.description: Optional source project ID (when source branch comes from another project/fork).

targetProjectId.description: Optional target project ID (when target branch belongs to another project/fork).

commentBody.description: Optional initial comment to create along with the change request.

tool_schemas.name: create_change_request_comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment on the specified change request and returns the created comment. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `commentBody` is empty/invalid or the ID format is invalid, `NOT_FOUND` if the change request does not exist or is not visible, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token cannot comment on the change request.

changeRequestId.description: Change request ID to comment on.

tool_schemas.name: list_change_request_comments
tool_schemas.description: Lists comments for a change request in creation-time order and returns a paged result set with up to `limit` comments and a `cursor` to retrieve subsequent pages. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid IDs/enum values or out-of-range paging parameters, `NOT_FOUND` if the change request does not exist or is not visible, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token lacks permission to read comments on the change request.

changeRequestId.description: Change request ID whose comments to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of comments to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: list_change_request_patch_sets
tool_schemas.description: Lists patch sets (revisions) for a Codeup change request and returns a paged result set with up to `limit` patch sets and a `cursor` for the next page, sorted by the requested field and order. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid `change_request_id`, invalid sort options, or out-of-range paging parameters, `NOT_FOUND` if the change request does not exist or is not visible, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token is not permitted to read patch sets for the change request.

change_request_id.description: ID of the Codeup change request to list patch sets for.

limit.description: Maximum number of patch sets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort_by.description: Field to sort patch sets by.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_organization_info
tool_schemas.description: Returns the organization context resolved for the current access token, including organization details and the current-user membership context; if `organization_id` is provided, we resolve and return that organization when it is accessible, otherwise we return the token-derived current organization. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `organization_id` is malformed, `NOT_FOUND` if the specified organization does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token is missing, invalid, or does not grant access to any organization context.

organization_id.description: Optional organization ID to request; if omitted, the token-derived current organization takes precedence.

tool_schemas.name: get_user_organizations
tool_schemas.description: Lists the organizations the current user belongs to and returns a paged result set with up to `limit` organizations and a `cursor` for the next page, optionally filtered by `status`. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` for invalid enum values or out-of-range paging parameters, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token is missing/invalid or the caller is not permitted to enumerate organization memberships.

limit.description: Maximum number of organizations to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_user
tool_schemas.description: Returns the user identity resolved for the current access token; if `user_id` is provided, we return that user only when it is accessible to the caller, otherwise we return the token-derived current user. Raises `VALIDATION_ERROR` if `user_id` is malformed, `NOT_FOUND` if the specified user does not exist or is not visible, and `UNAUTHORIZED`/`FORBIDDEN` if the token is missing, invalid, or not permitted to read user information.

user_id.description: Optional user ID to request; if omitted, the token-derived current user takes precedence.

tool_schemas.name: get_project
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full metadata for the specified Yunxiao project, including its identifiers and current status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is missing or does not match the required format, NOT_FOUND if no such project exists, and FORBIDDEN if the access token does not have permission to view the project in its organization context.

project_id.description: ID of the project to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: search_projects
tool_schemas.description: Searches projects visible in the caller’s organization context and returns a cursor-paged list of matching projects, ordered by sort_by/sort_order; the response includes a next_cursor when more results are available and an empty list when none match. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including limit out of range or bad user ID formats), and FORBIDDEN if the token is not allowed to list projects for the organization scope implied by the token.

query.description: Free-text query matched against project name/key/description.

created_by_user_id.description: Filter projects created by the specified user.

involved_user_id.description: Filter projects the specified user is involved in.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: get_work_item
tool_schemas.description: Returns the full details for a single work item by ID, including its type, status, and key fields such as assignee/reporter when present. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if work_item_id is missing or malformed, NOT_FOUND if the work item does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the containing project.

work_item_id.description: ID of the work item to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: search_workitems
tool_schemas.description: Searches work items visible to the caller, optionally scoped to a project, and returns a cursor-paged list of work items matching the provided filters; the response includes a next_cursor when additional pages exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs, invalid enum values, limit out of range, or inconsistent range filters (e.g., *_from after *_to or priority_min greater than priority_max), and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to query the specified project.

project_id.description: Filter work items to a specific project.

query.description: Free-text query matched against work item name/description.

labels.description: Filter to work items that have all of the specified labels.

due_date_from.description: Filter to work items with due_date on/after this timestamp.

due_date_to.description: Filter to work items with due_date on/before this timestamp.

created_at_from.description: Filter to work items created on/after this timestamp.

created_at_to.description: Filter to work items created on/before this timestamp.

updated_at_from.description: Filter to work items updated on/after this timestamp.

updated_at_to.description: Filter to work items updated on/before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of work items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

sort_by.description: Field to sort work items by.

tool_schemas.name: get_pipeline
tool_schemas.description: Returns details for a single pipeline owned by the given organization, including its configuration summary and current status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if organization_id or pipeline_id are missing or do not match the expected formats, NOT_FOUND if the pipeline does not exist under that organization, and FORBIDDEN if the token does not grant access to that organization’s pipelines.

organization_id.description: Organization identity ID that owns the pipeline.

tool_schemas.name: list_pipelines
tool_schemas.description: Lists pipelines under the specified organization and returns a cursor-paged result set filtered and sorted as requested; the response includes next_cursor when more pipelines are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values (including limit out of range or invalid timestamps), NOT_FOUND if the organization_id does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list pipelines for that organization.

organization_id.description: Organization identity ID to list pipelines for.

name_contains.description: Filter pipelines where name contains this substring.

created_after.description: Only return pipelines created after this timestamp.

created_before.description: Only return pipelines created before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of pipelines to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: smart_list_pipelines
tool_schemas.description: Applies the natural-language query (including time phrases such as “today” or “this week”) to search pipelines in the specified organization and returns a cursor-paged list of matches; the response includes next_cursor when additional results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if the query cannot be parsed into supported filters, if limit is out of range, or if IDs are malformed, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to search pipelines for the organization.

organization_id.description: Organization identity ID to search pipelines for.

query.description: Natural language query used to filter pipelines (may include time references like 'today' or 'this week').

status.description: Optional status filter applied in addition to the query.

limit.description: Maximum number of pipelines to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_pipeline_run
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new run for the specified pipeline and returns the created run record (including its run identifier and initial queued/running status) using the supplied parameters object when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if organization_id/pipeline_id are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the pipeline does not exist under the organization, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot run the pipeline, and CONFLICT if the pipeline is not in a runnable state (for example disabled or deleted).

organization_id.description: Organization identity ID that owns the pipeline.

parameters.description: Optional pipeline run parameters object passed to the run.

tool_schemas.name: get_latest_pipeline_run
tool_schemas.description: Returns the most recent pipeline run for the given pipeline (optionally restricted to runs with the requested status); if no run matches the criteria, returns NOT_FOUND. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if IDs are malformed or the status value is invalid, NOT_FOUND if the pipeline does not exist under the organization or no qualifying runs exist, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view pipeline runs for that organization.

organization_id.description: Organization identity ID that owns the pipeline.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline ID to fetch the latest run for.

status.description: If provided, only consider runs in this status when selecting the latest.

tool_schemas.name: get_pipeline_run
tool_schemas.description: [Pipeline Management] Get details of a specific pipeline run instance

organization_id.description: Organization identity ID that owns the pipeline run.

tool_schemas.name: list_pipeline_runs
tool_schemas.description: Lists pipeline run instances in the specified organization and returns a cursor-paginated collection ordered by the requested sort field and direction (use limit and cursor to page). Validates ID formats and filter ranges (e.g., run_number >= 1 and started_after/started_before are RFC3339 date-times), and rejects invalid enum values with INVALID_ARGUMENT. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the access token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot access the organization, NOT_FOUND if organization_id (or a provided pipeline_id / triggered_by_user_id) does not exist in that organization, and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when request rate/quota limits are exceeded.

organization_id.description: Organization identity ID to list pipeline runs for.

pipeline_id.description: Filter runs to a specific pipeline ID.

triggered_by_user_id.description: Filter runs by the user who triggered them.

started_after.description: Only return runs started after this timestamp.

started_before.description: Only return runs started before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of pipeline runs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_pipeline_jobs_by_category
tool_schemas.description: Lists jobs (tasks) for a given pipeline run within an organization, filtered by category (currently DEPLOY only) and optionally by status, returning a cursor-paginated collection (limit/cursor). Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when IDs do not match the required patterns, category is not DEPLOY, status is not supported, or paging parameters are out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks access to the organization or run, NOT_FOUND if organization_id or pipeline_run_id does not exist (or is not visible in the organization), and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when rate/quota limits are hit.

organization_id.description: Organization identity ID that owns the pipeline jobs.

pipeline_run_id.description: Pipeline run ID to list jobs for.

category.description: Job category to filter by (currently only DEPLOY is supported).

status.description: Optional filter for job run status.

limit.description: Maximum number of jobs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: list_pipeline_job_historys
tool_schemas.description: Lists execution history records for a specific pipeline job and returns a cursor-paginated collection sorted by the requested time field (use limit/cursor to page). Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when pipeline_job_id is malformed, status/sort values are unsupported, or limit is out of bounds. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the job, NOT_FOUND if the pipeline_job_id does not exist (or is not visible), and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when rate/quota limits are exceeded.

pipeline_job_id.description: ID of the pipeline job whose execution history to list.

status.description: Filter job run history by execution status.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

limit.description: Maximum number of job run history records to return.

sort_by.description: Field to sort job run history by.

sort_order.description: Sort order for the job run history list.

tool_schemas.name: execute_pipeline_job_run
tool_schemas.description: Manually starts a job execution for the specified pipeline_job_id within the given pipeline_run_id and returns the created job run record (including its initial status/identifiers). Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when IDs are malformed or the parameters object is not valid for the job, and CONFLICT when the job cannot be started due to the run/job state (for example, the run is completed/canceled or the job is already running/completed and cannot be re-run in the same run). Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to execute jobs in the organization/run, NOT_FOUND if the pipeline_run_id or pipeline_job_id does not exist (or the job is not part of that run), and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when execution/rate quotas are exceeded.

pipeline_run_id.description: ID of the pipeline run instance in which to start the job.

pipeline_job_id.description: ID of the pipeline job definition to run within the pipeline run.

parameters.description: Optional parameter overrides for this job execution.

tool_schemas.name: get_pipeline_job_run_log
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the log content for a specific pipeline job run. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when pipeline_job_run_id is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the job run logs, NOT_FOUND if the pipeline_job_run_id does not exist (or is not visible), CONFLICT if logs are not available for the current job run state (for example, the job has not started yet), and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when rate/quota limits are exceeded.

pipeline_job_run_id.description: ID of the pipeline job run whose log content to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: list_package_repositories
tool_schemas.description: Lists package repositories visible to the caller in the current organization context implied by the access token, returning a cursor-paginated collection sorted by the requested field (use limit/cursor to page). Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT for unsupported repo_type/status/sort values or invalid paging parameters. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the token has no package-repository access for the organization context, and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when rate/quota limits are exceeded.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

limit.description: Maximum number of repositories to return.

sort_order.description: Sort order for the repository list.

tool_schemas.name: list_artifacts
tool_schemas.description: Lists artifacts in the specified package repository with optional name/version/status filters and returns a cursor-paginated collection sorted by the requested field (use limit/cursor to page). Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when package_repository_id is malformed, filter/sort values are unsupported, or paging parameters are out of range. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the package repository, NOT_FOUND if the package_repository_id does not exist (or is not visible), and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when rate/quota limits are exceeded.

package_repository_id.description: ID of the package repository to list artifacts from.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing.

limit.description: Maximum number of artifacts to return.

sort_order.description: Sort order for the artifact list.

tool_schemas.name: get_artifact
tool_schemas.description: Returns metadata for a single artifact identified by artifact_id. Raises INVALID_ARGUMENT when artifact_id is malformed. Raises UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the artifact’s repository, NOT_FOUND if the artifact_id does not exist (or is not visible), and RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED when rate/quota limits are exceeded.

artifact_id.description: ID of the artifact to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity derived from the presented api_token, including resolved user_id and organization_id, granted token_scopes, and current rate-limit/quota consumption. Refuses UNAUTHORIZED if the token is missing/invalid/expired, and FORBIDDEN if the token identity is not status='active'.

api_token.description: Active Yunxiao DevOps api_token used to authorize the request; must map to exactly one user_id and one organization_id.

tool_schemas.name: update_change_request_status
tool_schemas.description: Updates the lifecycle status of a change request to drive allowed state transitions (open->closed, closed->open, open->merged) and returns the updated change request. Refuses VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid transitions, FORBIDDEN if the token cannot update the change request, and NOT_FOUND if the change request does not exist.

api_token.description: Active Yunxiao DevOps api_token used to authorize the request.

status.description: Target lifecycle status; must be a valid transition from the current status.

merge_commit_message.description: Optional merge commit message used when transitioning to status='merged' (if supported by repository settings).

metadata.name: Yunxiao DevOps Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Yunxiao (Alibaba Cloud DevOps) organization data spanning identity (users/orgs), code management (repositories/branches/files/change requests), project management (projects/work items), pipelines (definitions, runs, jobs, logs), and package management (artifact repositories and a
